name: Tooltip
description: Radix Tooltip. Opens on hover and on keyboard focus. Requires TooltipProvider somewhere above it.
intent: Name a control whose purpose is not obvious from its appearance.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

parts.name: TooltipProvider
parts.note: Mount once high in the tree. Without it, Tooltip throws.

parts.name: TooltipTrigger
parts.note: Use asChild. The trigger must be focusable.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: The trigger must be focusable — a div will not do
notes: Opens on keyboard focus as well as hover. Radix handles this; do not reimplement it on mouse events.
Touch devices have no hover. Anything tooltip-only is invisible to those users — this is the reason for the critical-information rule.
A tooltip on an icon button supplies the visible hint; the button still needs aria-label for its accessible name.

forbiddenUsage: Tooltip as the only accessible name
agentRules: Never put critical information in a tooltip.
An icon button still needs aria-label — the tooltip is not a substitute.
Mount TooltipProvider once at the app root, not per tooltip.
